# Overview

This document loads pre-computed batch simulation results (from `02_run_fixed.jl`,
`02_run_vcov.jl`, `02_run_bootstrap.jl`, `02_run_sir.jl`) and presents all
operating characteristic tables — both absolute and relative to the Fixed
(plug-in) method.

::: {.callout-note}
## No Heavy Computation
All simulation results are loaded from saved `.jls` files. This document renders
quickly — no simulations are re-run.
:::

# Load Results

```{julia}
#| output: false
include(joinpath(@__DIR__, "common.jl"))

# Resolve results next to this document rather than at an absolute path. The
# previous value pointed at /home/jrun/data/code/teva-olanzapine/..., which is
# both machine-specific and a DIFFERENT project directory from the one these
# files live in, so neither report could render anywhere but one machine.
const RESULTS_DIR = @__DIR__
println("Loading per-method batch results from $RESULTS_DIR ...")
results = load_all_method_results(dir = RESULTS_DIR)
all_batches  = results.all_batches
all_summary  = results.all_summary
relative_df  = results.relative_df
nothing
```

```{julia}
#| echo: false
println("all_batches: $(nrow(all_batches)) rows")
println("all_summary: $(nrow(all_summary)) rows")
println("relative_df: $(nrow(relative_df)) rows")
```

# Absolute Results

## Power Estimates — T/R = 1.0

Point estimate (%) and 95% CI across batches:

```{julia}
#| echo: false
power_at_1 = filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == 1.0, all_summary)
power_at_1.display = fmt_ci.(power_at_1.mean_rate, power_at_1.ci_lo, power_at_1.ci_hi)
display(unstack(select(power_at_1, :n_per_arm, :method, :display), :n_per_arm, :method, :display))
```

# Results — Relative to Fixed

All tables below show VCOV, Bootstrap, and SIR benchmarked against the Fixed (plug-in)
method. The Fixed column shows the absolute reference value for context.

```{julia}
#| output: false
#| code-summary: "Helper functions for relative tables"

function display_diff_table(tr_val)
    sub = filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == tr_val, relative_df)
    sub_disp = copy(sub)
    sub_disp.display = fmt_diff.(sub_disp.abs_diff, sub_disp.abs_diff_ci_lo, sub_disp.abs_diff_ci_hi)
    diff_wide = unstack(select(sub_disp, :n_per_arm, :method, :display), :n_per_arm, :method, :display)

    fixed_abs = filter(r -> r.method == "Fixed" && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, all_summary)
    fixed_abs_disp = DataFrame(n_per_arm = fixed_abs.n_per_arm,
        Fixed_ref = fmt_ci.(fixed_abs.mean_rate, fixed_abs.ci_lo, fixed_abs.ci_hi))
    display(innerjoin(fixed_abs_disp, diff_wide, on = :n_per_arm))
end

function display_ratio_table(tr_val)
    sub = filter(r -> r.tr_ratio == tr_val, relative_df)
    sub_disp = copy(sub)
    sub_disp.display = fmt_ratio.(sub_disp.ratio, sub_disp.ratio_ci_lo, sub_disp.ratio_ci_hi)
    ratio_wide = unstack(select(sub_disp, :n_per_arm, :method, :display), :n_per_arm, :method, :display)

    fixed_abs = filter(r -> r.method == "Fixed" && r.tr_ratio == tr_val, all_summary)
    fixed_disp = DataFrame(n_per_arm = fixed_abs.n_per_arm,
        Fixed_ref = fmt_ci.(fixed_abs.mean_rate, fixed_abs.ci_lo, fixed_abs.ci_hi))
    display(innerjoin(fixed_disp, ratio_wide, on = :n_per_arm))
end
nothing
```
